title: Recorded work-tape boundary exit
statement: Given a deterministic $k$-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet and record data, the returned Boolean is true exactly when some work tape is marked as being at its left edge and its action moves left, or is marked as being at its right edge and its action moves right; otherwise it is false.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A deterministic $k$-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet
Record data with left-edge and right-edge flags for each work tape
